name: H1-PA: the PCA-aligned redesign of H1, three arms; the third adds 2.96M of pure fluid-reasoning data to E1's
decided_by: maintainer, 2026-10-24, two decisions (logs/budget/decisions.md :: H1-PA, and :: H1-PA reasoning augmentation)
supersedes: H1 for promotion only (logs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/plans/h1_annulment.json); and, within this study, the 70/30 D4-Reasoning arm (audited in audit/h1pa_audit.json, cancelled before any training)
status: FROZEN 2026-10-25 for formal training and evaluation: the data (the whole-unit fluid increment, audit/h1pa_fluid_whole_units.json), the recipe, the evaluation protocol and the decision rule (plans/h1pa_preregistration.json) are fixed before any H1-PA model exists. Student training and evaluation are NOT authorized: they need their own grant (plans/h1pa_training_application.json), with the $712.17 project cap raised to fit
question: Under E1's baseline kept exactly, does adding 2.96M supervised tokens of pure fluid-reasoning data improve the D4 student's reasoning correctness on unseen problems?

comparisons.A: D4-Original - PCA-Original: the initialization effect; data, packing, recipe, seeds and evaluation identical
comparisons.B: D4-Augmented - D4-Original: the effect of adding the fluid increment WITH the optimizer steps and FLOPs it brings; not the data content's isolated causal effect
comparisons.C: D4-Augmented - PCA-Original: end to end, descriptive; changes initialization and data together

not_studied: no mixture-ratio search; no extra arm (no PCA-Augmented, so no 2x2 and no interaction); no step-matched or epoch-matched alternative schedule

PCA-Original.execution: reuse the trained checkpoints; re-evaluate only

20260801._durability: uploaded to the relay 2026-10-24 beside seed 20260726's path, with its config, tokenizer files and pod hashes (e1_r2960k_sb_pca_pod_hashes.txt); read back in full and re-hashed: all six files match the dev-box copy, model.safetensors b658fe39... (relay LFS sha256 the same). Room came from retiring one historical Stage-3 checkpoint under AGENTS.md 2.5 (logs/maintenance/inventories/checkpoint_tombstones.json :: stage3_s2v1_from_s1)

D4-Original.execution: train, one run per seed: 1,944 sequences, 3 epochs, 2,916 optimizer steps

D4-Augmented.execution: train, one run per seed: 3 epochs of the merged set's 2,468 sequences = 3,702 optimizer steps (E1's builder rule), never forced to 2,916 and never padded to it by repetition

d4_top1.tokenizer: the PCA init directory's tokenizer (the record's tokenizer_binding): the files E1 loaded

e1_2p96M._pack: E1's own pack: E1 trained from artifacts/stage3/ladder_uniform, whose blocks/ladder/audit hashes E1's run manifests record and these files carry; never re-sampled, re-packed or modified
e1_2p96M.validation_sequences: 16, from sequence 2941 (aadistill.data.ladder.select_val_blocks): every arm validates on these

fluid_increment.what: 2,960,000 supervised tokens from the five P10.2 primary axes only: verified teacher-native targets from P1 and P1t (stage2.reasoning_master@v3's primary cells), plus a top-up of unused tasks; no supporting data, no @v3 quota
fluid_increment.pooling: the three sessions merged by corpus_feasibility.merge; PA1's runner bytes differ from P1's and P1t's only by the opt-in --decoding, and pooling them rests on audit/h1pa_runner_equivalence.json (generate path identical: diff, replay of both versions on PA1's tasks, PA1's seeds and sampling)
fluid_increment.mixture: the pool's own supervised-token composition by cell, declared before packing (h1pa_audit sessions) and unchanged by the whole-unit admission; the admitted set's realized mixture is within 0.1 pp of it in every cell; never tuned on any result
fluid_increment.packing: E1's sequential packer (scripts/shared/data/build_token_ladder.py) with --no-terminal-truncation, the packer's own allow_terminal_truncation=False: every verified trajectory is packed whole. This differs from E1's part, which keeps E1's terminal truncation; the difference is recorded, not hidden
fluid_increment.relay: AlphaAvatar/aadistill-artifacts :: stage2_h1pa/packs/D4A_fluid_whole (+ its builder input), read back, 0 mismatches
fluid_increment.never: best-fit or best-fit-decreasing packing; repeated samples; a lowered correctness standard; supporting data counted as fluid

superseded_builds.why_superseded: maintainer 2026-10-24: it cut the sequential pack at the first sequences reaching 2.96M, which split 4 multi-turn episodes (their later turns untrained); an episode's turns are trained all or none. Kept as evidence, never trained on

admission.rule: whole units: units in the order of their first session in the packer's own seed-free stratified interleave on the declared mixture, each with ALL its sessions, until the admitted supervised tokens reach 2,960,000 (h1pa_audit admit_whole_units); the stop falls on a unit boundary, and the pack of exactly those units is trained in full
admission.excluded_are: all 39 from PA1: within each cell the packer's order lists sessions in corpus order (P1, then P1t, then PA1), so the top-up's units come last; nothing reads a result
admission.never_trained_or_validated: the 39 excluded units (2 episodes): in no training and no validation set

fluid_increment.isolation: audit/h1pa_fluid_whole_units.json :: isolation, from the real training and validation members

e1_2p96M_plus_fluid.layout: E1's 1,944 training sequences byte for byte, then the fluid increment's sequences as packed, then E1's 16 validation sequences (h1pa_audit merge); E1's trainer reads it through aadistill.data.ladder.ladder_blocks unchanged
e1_2p96M_plus_fluid.verified: E1's 1,944 training and 16 validation sequences byte for byte, the fluid part as packed (audit/h1pa_fluid_whole_units.json :: identity)

20260801.recorded_in: configs/stages/stage-3/e6b/provenance.json :: e6b_p2_r2960k_sb.rung_parent_sha256 (E1 sb's run manifest was not preserved)

recipe.derive: a D4 run's config is its seed's E1 config with run_name, _purpose, out_dir, data_dir, student_path (the D4 directory) and tokenizer_source (the PCA init directory E1 loaded its tokenizer from) replaced; D4-Augmented also replaces rung (its training supervised tokens) and the schedule E1's builder derives from the sequence count (total_steps = ceil(3 x sequences / 2), warmup max(10, round(0.05 T)), eval every max(25, T // 8), save every max(200, T // 2)); every other key, nested keys included, unchanged (h1pa_driver.derive_recipe checks it)
recipe.facts: batch size 2 sequences (blocks_per_step), micro-batch size 1 (micro_blocks), gradient accumulation steps 2, sequence length 8,192 (block_len), 3 epochs, AdamW lr 5e-5 betas (0.9, 0.95) eps 1e-8 weight decay 0.01, gradient clipping 1.0, cosine to 0.1 of peak, CE 0.25 + KD 1.0 (T 1, KD over every non-padding position), fp32 weights with bf16 autocast, gradient checkpointing, teacher Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507@768f209d9ea81521153ed38c47d515654e938aea in bf16, the trainer's seeded per-epoch permutation of sequences

evaluation.set: eval-set-1 (its registered identity, validity mask and scoring semantics unchanged)
evaluation.primary: correctness on the formal static items of fluid_reasoning_720 (held-out rule families), each axis apart; every other unit reported beside it
evaluation.every_checkpoint: two PCA-Original, two D4-Original and two D4-Augmented checkpoints, each generated once under the same protocol and seed rule
evaluation.never_compared_with: any greedy result, E1's and H1's included

hardware.why: E1 trained this exact configuration on L40S with a 39.96 GB logged peak (sa train_log.jsonl :: gpu_mem_gb); D4-Augmented's sequences have the same length and micro-batch
hardware.datacenters_with_l40s_and_volumes: chosen at launch from a live query (2026-10-24: EU-NL-1, EUR-IS-2, US-MO-1, stock Low in each)

_frozen: set true 2026-10-25 with the preregistration; h1pa_driver refuses a formal launch otherwise

driver.units: <arm>-s<seed> over arms x seeds: PCA-Original evaluated only; D4-Original and D4-Augmented trained, then evaluated
driver.pack_layout: <--pack-root>/<dataset key>/{blocks.npz, audit.jsonl, ladder.json}: e1_2p96M for D4-Original, e1_2p96M_plus_fluid for D4-Augmented
driver.checkpoint_layout: <--checkpoint-root>/<seed>/ for PCA-Original, re-identified by model.safetensors' sha256
driver.tokenizer_source: artifacts/stages/stage-1/qwen3_0p6b_init_v0/checkpoint (the PCA init directory E1 loaded its tokenizer from; D4 Top-1 carries no tokenizer)

relay_inputs._: what a session's pod pulls from AlphaAvatar/aadistill-artifacts, hash-pinned; each file's sha256 was read back from the relay (2026-10-24) and equals the dev-box copy. h1pa_launch stages only what the session's units read
